messages:
Ravi: Tiny idea  who wants to do a holiday plant-card chain? We each add a little plant-related note to a card and pass it along the bench. Low-effort, low-waste. :seedling:
June: Love this. Can remote folks join? I can mail a small paper card and a photo of my succie. :mailbox_with_mail:
Marta: Yes please include remote! Maybe we create one central card in the office and then scan/send around so everyone signs digitally too. :sparkles:
Kofi: Also, can we add a short plant care tip on each card? I can write one about watering cadence for snake plants. :herb:
Ravi: Good call. Plan: I'll leave a blank kraft card on the kitchen bench at 11:30. Sign, add a tiny note, then move it to the next desk. Remote folks DM me and I'll print their notes into the card.
June: Quick poll: should we also include a tiny non-food token (like a seed packet) or keep it paper-only? React :one: seed packet, :two: paper-only.
Marta: :two: paper-only inbox for allergies & cleanliness.
Kofi: :one: seed packet from the free office garden stash would be cute.
Anya: :two: prefer paper-only. Also shoutout to Ravi for last week's plant-swap organization  very smooth. :clap:
ops-bot: Reminder: Office mail drop policy: personal items under 1 lb can be dropped at reception. Staff are responsible for postage for shipped items. :information_source:
Ravi: Thanks ops-bot. Remote people who send notes, if you want seeds included DM me and we'll coordinate postage. Otherwise paper-only is default.
June: I'll DM. Also can we add a cheeky micro-poll inside the card: "Which holiday plant are you?" Options: Poinsettia, Snake Plant, Succulent, Mystery Fern. Short answers welcome. :two_hearts:
Marta: Adding a small doodle corner. I will draw a tiny fern.
Kofi: I'll write the watering tip and a tiny haiku. Yes, a haiku. It's mandatory. :grin:
Ravi: Haiku requirement accepted. If you can't write one, include a doodle. Both valid.
June: Remote crew already sent tiny scanned stickers. I printed them and stuck them on the inner flap. Looks adorable. :yay:
Anya: If anyone wants help mailing or needs a postage voucher, ping me. We have a small social budget for low-cost postage. :money_with_wings:
Marta: Also adding a tiny thank-you note to facilities for letting us use the common bench for crafty chaos. :heart:
Kofi: ETA: I will do an office pass by 3pm to collect signatures and then put the card on reception for anyone leaving early to sign.
Ravi: Perfect. If you don't get to sign in person, send me a DM before 5pm and I'll include you. I'll post a photo of the finished card after the handoff. :camera_with_flash:
June: Ooh photos please. Also, minutely important question: anyone bringing hot cider to celebrate? Not mandatory, but it pairs well with plant-card energy. :apple:
Marta: I'm bringing a thermos of ginger tea. Labeling it "shared, please use paper cups."
Ravi: Team vote on seed packet now is leaning paper-only but people can add seeds by request. Closing poll at 2pm. Thanks all!
